entities.name: Mousefolk
entities.description: One of the animalfolk of Bloomburrow, plucky and loyal seekers of adventure, often leaders.

entities.name: Birdfolk
entities.description: Closest natural allies of the mousefolk.

entities.name: Order of the Holly Leaf
entities.description: A legendary order that includes mousefolk soldiers.

entities.name: Lily Emberseed
entities.description: A mousefolk who repelled the Calamity Beasts and ended the War of Cinders.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Lily's descendant who assembled a rag-tag group to defend Valley around 4564 AR.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Monsters repelled by Lily and later threatening Valley.

entities.name: Assault on Delverhaugh
entities.description: Event that some mice helped repel.

events.summary: Lily Emberseed repels the Calamity Beasts, ending the War of Cinders.
events.quote: the mousefolk Lily Emberseed repelled the Calamity Beasts , ending the War of Cinders

events.summary: Around 4564 AR Mabel assembles a rag-tag group of warriors and misfits to defend Valley.
events.quote: assembled a rag-tag group of warriors and misfits to defend Valley against the Calamity Beasts

relations.quote: They are the closest natural allies of the Birdfolk .
